player_prompt.intro:
Esi enye Dɔdzikplɔla {player_id} le SimpleTak.
Le bɔdɛ la, ame nyɔnu wɔwɔ dze eɖokui '{player_stone}' gɔme, na ame ɖɔkplɔla wɔwɔ dze eɖokui '{opponent_stone}'.

Le eŋu la, xɔ celli si (le numɔ ŋuti) kple dze eɖokui. 
Ɖe si, '[12]' dze eɖokui le celli 12.

Eɖokui enye kuɖe eɖokui si wɔ nɔnɔme le bɔdɛ la (tɔp-to-bɔtɔm kple left-to-right).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: Ʋu ƒe nɔnɔme si mele eteƒe o
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Celli numɔ {cell_num} ɖo ɖɔ. Se be enye 0 kple {max_board_num}.

outcome.winner: Dɔdzikplɔla {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') dze eɖokui si wɔ nɔnɔme.
outcome.draw: Ame sia ame le kplɔ̃a dzi. Ewɔ ɖeka!
